cues.en: All right.
In this lecture we are going to look at inserting a new node at any given location in a double linked
list.
So we have a circled double linked list like this.
And we want to insert new node at the index of two.
So in this case first we need to create a pointer which is located before the index that we want to
insert.
So we want to insert at index of two.
And here we need to get the node which is located at the index of one.
So we can do it by using the get method.
So we know that when we are passing the index to the get method, it is returning that node from the
so-called double linked list.
Now the next step is we are going to update the next reference of the new node to point to the node
which is located after the pointer that we have created over here.
So in this case the pointer locates at the index of one.
So we need to update it to point to the node which is located after this pointer which is the node at
the index of two.
Then we are going to update the previous reference of this newly created node to point to the node which
is located before this node, which is in the current pointer.
Then the next thing that we need to do, we need to update the the next node's previous reference to
point to to this newly created node.
Then we need to update the current node's next reference to point to this newly created node.
Then after that, this node will be inserted at the index of two over here.
So these are the steps that we need to follow when we are inserting a new node at any given location
in circle double linked list.
